notes: The agentry operating system. Persistent sessions with isolated cwd, env, and process table. Filesystem shared under work/<session>/. Dispatches to agentry-kernel on 127.0.0.1:7864. Actions: session.create|get|list|cwd|env, fs.read|write|list, shell.spawn|write|read|kill|list, python.run|install|version, node.run|install|npx|version, git.clone|status|commit|log|version, proc.start|status|stop|logs|list, health. Not a bash sandbox — a typed execution environment with state.
